text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Losses of touristic group Torralta amounted to 1.7 billion escudos in 1996, double of the previous year. This situation is due to the high debts of the company, at a time when retail group Sonae is going to buy the company's credits from the state.

- Report from the European Commission on equality oportunities says the position of women in the labour market has improved, although in Portugal there is still a low level of representation in the services sector.

- Portugal Telecom is pushing ahead with concentration strategy with joint venture between Marconi and Telepac, in which it has an importante stake, the secretary of state for Housing and Telecomunications Leonor Coutinho said.
- Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco says opposition proposals for transferring some tax revenues to local authorities will increase deficit of the public sector.

- Bourse capitalisation of telecomunications company Telecel falls 35.8 billion escudos in the last six sessions of the bourse, from 329.8 to 294 billion escudos, when its direct competitor TMN announced price cuts.
